notes: Implemented Phase 5 of Change Requests Implementation Plan (CR-15, CR-14, CR-12, CR-02). CR-14: Refactored all 6 handler modules (layout, crop, background, title, overlay, file) to use injected callbacks instead of calling this._scheduleRender() directly — full DIP compliance. Callbacks receive Vue instance (vm) as parameter. CR-15: Removed hardcoded DOM IDs from createCollageMethods, createCollageLifecycle, and createFileHandlers — all accept domIds config with defaults. CR-12: Deferred separate module extraction; internal functions in createCollageMethods.js already achieve SRP separation. CR-02: Added v-show for gutter slider on hexagonal layout and getLayoutOptions() to LayoutGenerator for OCP-compliant UI option visibility. Added 34 tests covering DOM ID injection, callback pattern, getLayoutOptions, and methods composition. All 27 test files pass (1235 total tests, 1 pre-existing failure).
